title: Market, Classifieds, Housing and Store listings share on the Stage card with their own photo

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];for(const d of ['market','classifieds','housing','store']){for(const f of ['opengraph-image.tsx','twitter-image.tsx'])if(!fs.existsSync('app/(public)/'+d+'/[id]/'+f))bad.push(d+' has no '+f)}const seo=fs.readFileSync('lib/listings-shared/listing-seo.ts','utf8');if(/images:\\s*image/.test(seo)||/ROOT_OG_IMAGES/.test(seo))bad.push('listing-seo still owns og images, which suppresses the card');if(!fs.existsSync('lib/og/listing-card.tsx'))bad.push('lib/og/listing-card.tsx missing');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1270: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1269, same owner request (2026-10-21): the marketplace listing pages shared the raw first photo, or the generic site card when a listing had none. Each of /market/[id], /classifieds/[id], /housing/[id] and /store/[id] now has an opengraph-image and twitter-image that draw the Stage layout (lib/og/listing-card.tsx over lib/og/stage-card.tsx) with the listing's own photo, its short price as the chip, category and coarse place on the facts row, and the first line of its description. Each route reads the same record its page renders and only active listings are drawn; anything the page would 404 gets an identity-free card. Housing carries the coarse place label only, never the address. listingMetadata and the Store page no longer declare openGraph images, because owning the key suppresses the file card. Member profiles need no new card: the public profile is the Spotlight, done in LIVE-1269, and /people/[handle] is signed-in only.
